product_skus.predicate: tenant_id=25 and product_id in (select id from products where tenant_id=25 and name like 'race-sweep%')

orders.predicate: tenant_id=25 and (remark like 'race-sweep%' or customer_name like 'race-sweep%')

inbound_orders.predicate: tenant_id=25 and (coalesce(supplier,'') like 'race-sweep%' or coalesce(remark,'') like 'race-sweep%' or coalesce(supplier_doc_no,'') like 'race-sweep%')

stock_batches.predicate: tenant_id=25 and (product_id in (select id from products where tenant_id=25 and name like 'race-sweep%') or sku_id in (select id from product_skus where tenant_id=25 and product_id in (select id from products where tenant_id=25 and name like 'race-sweep%')) or supplier like 'race-sweep%' or dye_lot like 'race-sweep%' or inbound_order_id in (select id from inbound_orders where tenant_id=25 and (supplier like 'race-sweep%' or remark like 'race-sweep%')))

stock_batch_consumptions.predicate: tenant_id=25 and (stocktake_run_id like 'race-sweep%' or batch_id in (select id from stock_batches where tenant_id=25 and (supplier like 'race-sweep%' or dye_lot like 'race-sweep%')))

stock_ledger_entries.predicate: tenant_id=25 and (product_id in (select id from products where tenant_id=25 and name like 'race-sweep%') or sku_id in (select id from product_skus where tenant_id=25 and product_id in (select id from products where tenant_id=25 and name like 'race-sweep%')) or note like '%race-sweep%' or coalesce(ref_no,'') in (select order_no from orders where tenant_id=25 and (remark like 'race-sweep%' or customer_name like 'race-sweep%')) or coalesce(ref_no,'') in (select inbound_no from inbound_orders where tenant_id=25 and (supplier like 'race-sweep%' or remark like 'race-sweep%')))

order_shipments.predicate: tenant_id=25 and order_id in (select id from orders where tenant_id=25 and (remark like 'race-sweep%' or customer_name like 'race-sweep%'))

finance_transactions.predicate: tenant_id=25 and (order_id in (select id from orders where tenant_id=25 and (remark like 'race-sweep%' or customer_name like 'race-sweep%')) or coalesce(order_no,'') in (select order_no from orders where tenant_id=25 and (remark like 'race-sweep%' or customer_name like 'race-sweep%')) or coalesce(remark,'') like '%race-sweep%')

processing_orders.predicate: tenant_id=25 and (order_id in (select id from orders where tenant_id=25 and (remark like 'race-sweep%' or customer_name like 'race-sweep%')) or coalesce(processing_order_no,'') in (select order_no from orders where tenant_id=25 and (remark like 'race-sweep%' or customer_name like 'race-sweep%')))
